home.intro: Share your health concerns with HealthSpeak AI in the language you are comfortable with. Your information will be organised for medical staff review.
home.howHelp: How can we help you today?
home.f1d: Speak or type your concern in the way that feels natural.
home.f2d: Communicate comfortably in your preferred language.
home.f3d: Start your intake whenever you need assistance.
home.howIntro: Share what you are experiencing. HealthSpeak AI helps structure your information so the medical team can review it.
home.s1d: Start with voice or text in a language you are comfortable with.
home.s2d: Describe your symptoms and answer a few simple questions.
home.s3d: Your structured intake is routed to the appropriate medical team.
home.ctaText: Choose your language and start a conversation.
home.q1: Can I use my preferred language?
home.a1: Yes. HealthSpeak AI works in English, Hindi and Urdu. Choose your display language at the top of the page and the language you will speak in on the voice or chat screen.
home.q2: Does the AI provide a medical diagnosis?
home.a2: No. HealthSpeak AI writes down and organises what you share so that medical staff can review it. It does not diagnose or prescribe; clinical decisions are made by the care team.
home.a3: Yes, on the hospital's own system, and only after you give consent. Voice recordings are turned into text on the hospital's own server and the audio is then deleted. Only authorised staff can see your information.
home.footer: © 2026 HealthSpeak AI · Development version, not yet approved for real patients

chat.greeting: Hello! Welcome to HealthSpeak AI. I can help you share your health concerns in your preferred language. What symptoms or concerns would you like to tell us about today?
chat.scriptHintHi: It looks like you are typing Hindi in English letters. For the most accurate result, please type in Devanagari (हिंदी) or tap the microphone and speak. If you are writing in English, switch the language to English.
chat.scriptHintUr: It looks like you are typing Urdu in English letters. For the most accurate result, please type in Urdu script (اردو) or tap the microphone and speak. If you are writing in English, switch the language to English.
